measurement_note: Bytes/words are exact. Input tokens use the existing conservative UTF-8 bytes/2 planner estimator, not Gemini tokenization or provider billing. No inference or generation calls.
rule_review: Strict JSON, batch/scene IDs, exact eight fields, input order, no extra/omitted scenes, echoed assigned roles.
Exact local precedence, adjacent compatible detail, story fallback for unresolved references only, meaningful subject anchor, semantic rather than lexical matching.
Concrete exact-phrase evidence; no generic topic/mood substitution; one physically plausible moment and coordinated narrated action; verb-first action when possible.
Static/abstract supported state, literal evidence over metaphor, named environment retained, necessary compatible details only, no invented events or continuity.
Ordinary human behavior/settings/objects/clutter/imperfection, no spectacle/advertising or generic placeholders unless narration-critical.
Honor pinned reusable style treatment across all existing dimensions, no copied reference content, photographic physical plausibility, optics rather than extra filming equipment.
Keep narrated participants/actions/roles; quality overrides soft shot scale while preserving medium/treatment; avoid tiny or incidental faces/distant frontal/full-body groups.
Human/reaction dominant chest-up facial evidence or supported rear/shoulder view; essential interactions and multiple participants retained; no invented solitude.
Environmental place/result focus, supported rear-facing participants, landscapes valid, no tiny essential faces in split views.
Close clear hand contact, ordinary grip/anatomy, no needless intertwined/overlapping/tiny/extra operations; preserve narrated precise action instead of aftermath.
Essential object/macro evidence at believable scale; no gratuitous people, props, apparatus or invented scientific/technical detail.

Authoritative subject/action/environment; essential composition in compiled fields, central and large for full/split zoom; audit-only lighting, pinned lighting authority, compatibility-only core/tags.
Core describes scene facts only; no repeated suffix/style metadata in scene facts or core.

All visible/invented typography, letters/digits, labels/markings/price tags/receipts/signs/inscriptions, branding/logos/watermarks, UI/screens/charts/diagrams, graphics/borders/overlays/transitions excluded.
Names/dates/addresses/quantities shown physically; blank unmarked sign/plaque surfaces; supported plain unbranded goods remain valid without invented details/copy/advertising.
Nonempty control-free text; unchanged 20/10/45 word targets and 240/120/600 character bounds; at most 12 unique nonempty lowercase tags, 80 characters, plain single-spaced words, no slug punctuation.
No model choice of duration/layout/role/avatar/style version/model/GPU/retry/fallback.
paid_compute: None activated; global inventory not queried.
